# IVX IA SENIOR DEVELOPER CERTIFICATION — FINAL CREDENTIAL BINDING, PUSH, DEPLOY, FEATURE, BUG FIX AND LIVE VERIFICATION

MODE: EXECUTE NOW
PRIORITY: P0
GOAL: Resume the existing certification from its current state and complete every blocked production phase. Do not rebuild the certification app from scratch.

CURRENT CERTIFICATION ARTIFACT:

Project:
ivx-senior-developer-certification

Existing location:
backend/cert-app/

Reported existing evidence:

- Approximately 1,283 lines of code
- 41 certification tests passing
- Architecture documentation complete
- Frontend complete locally
- Backend complete locally
- Database layer complete locally
- Security tests pass
- Queue/orchestration tests pass
- Existing IVX production unchanged
- Certification currently BLOCKED because GitHub, Render, and Supabase credentials were not available inside the certification worker

IMPORTANT:

Previous runtime audits already reported:

- GITHUB_TOKEN present and HTTP 200
- GITHUB_REPO_URL present and HTTP 200
- RENDER_API_KEY present and HTTP 200
- RENDER_SERVICE_ID present and HTTP 200
- SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY present and HTTP 200

Therefore:

DO NOT ask the owner to paste credentials.
DO NOT claim credentials are missing without a real runtime 401/403.
DO NOT restart the certification.
DO NOT recreate the application.
DO NOT modify IVX production business data.
DO NOT return another local-only report.

==================================================
ITEM 1 — RESUME THE EXISTING CERTIFICATION JOB
==================================================

Find the existing certification:

- QA ID
- root trace ID
- task ID
- job ID
- current stage
- current files
- existing test evidence

Resume from the first unfinished phase.

Do not create a duplicate project.

Return:

- QA ID
- Job ID
- Resume stage
- Existing project path
- Existing files preserved
- PASS/FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 2 — FIX CREDENTIAL BINDING TO THE WORKER
==================================================

Trace:

IVX Variables
→ backend runtime
→ task orchestrator
→ certification worker
→ GitHub client
→ Render client
→ Supabase client

For each stage return:

- file
- function
- expected variables
- actual variables available
- runtime context
- error
- trace ID
- PASS/FAIL

Verify inside the actual certification worker:

- GITHUB_TOKEN
- GITHUB_REPO_URL
- RENDER_API_KEY
- RENDER_SERVICE_ID
- SUPABASE_URL
- SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
- IVX_OWNER_TOKEN or canonical owner-auth mechanism

For every variable return only:

- present true/false
- loaded true/false
- safe authentication result
- HTTP status
- exact redacted error

Never return secret values.

Acceptance:

- Worker can read validated server-side clients or scoped credentials.
- No credential is copied into client code.
- No credential is placed in EXPO_PUBLIC variables.
- No 401/403 remains.

==================================================
ITEM 3 — STANDARDIZE OWNER AUTH
==================================================

Current inconsistency:

Some owner routes accept IVX_OWNER_TOKEN while the credential-audit route requires a Supabase JWT.

Choose and document one secure canonical owner-auth strategy.

Required behavior:

- valid owner → 200
- missing token → 401
- invalid token → 401
- authenticated non-owner → 403
- all dangerous developer routes use the same server-side owner verification
- no static token is exposed to the client
- no route silently accepts weaker authentication

Add regression tests.

==================================================
ITEM 4 — CREATE OR USE A SAFE CERTIFICATION REPOSITORY
==================================================

Preferred:

Create or use an isolated owner-controlled repository:

ivx-senior-developer-certification

If repository creation is not authorized, use an isolated branch or isolated folder in the owner-controlled repository with explicit certification boundaries.

Required proof:

- repository
- owner
- branch
- remote URL
- authentication result
- write permission
- no impact to IVX production branch

==================================================
ITEM 5 — PUSH THE EXISTING CERTIFICATION APPLICATION
==================================================

Run:

1. Inspect git status.
2. Review certification files.
3. Confirm no production secrets.
4. Confirm no IVX production data.
5. Commit the existing certification application.
6. Push to the isolated remote/branch.
7. Read remote SHA.

Return:

- files committed
- commit message
- commit SHA
- remote SHA
- push timestamp
- GitHub API status

Acceptance:

Local SHA = remote SHA

==================================================
ITEM 6 — PROVISION ISOLATED DATA
==================================================

The certification application must not use IVX production business tables.

Use one of:

- separate Supabase project
- separate schema with strict isolation
- isolated test database

Create:

- schema
- migrations
- indexes
- constraints
- RLS
- seed records
- rollback migration

Verify:

- no query touches production members
- no query touches production investors
- no query touches production buyers
- no query touches production deals
- no service-role key appears in client code

==================================================
ITEM 7 — DEPLOY THE CERTIFICATION APPLICATION
==================================================

Create or bind an isolated Render service.

Required:

- certification service ID
- deployment from certification SHA
- required server variables
- no production database usage
- health route
- readiness route
- authenticated CRUD route
- trace IDs
- logs
- rollback reference

Return:

- Render service
- Deploy ID
- Deployed SHA
- Build start
- Build finish
- Boot time
- Health
- Readiness
- Live URL

Acceptance:

GitHub remote SHA
=
Render deployed SHA
=
runtime health SHA

==================================================
ITEM 8 — LIVE PRODUCTION SMOKE TEST
==================================================

Against the certification live URL test:

- frontend loads
- health → 200
- readiness → 200
- login
- authenticated list
- detail
- create
- edit
- validation error
- unauthorized request
- forbidden request
- not found
- trace ID
- database persistence
- page refresh persistence

Return actual HTTP statuses and trace IDs.

==================================================
ITEM 9 — SECOND FEATURE DELIVERY
==================================================

Add this feature to the already-live certification app:

“Add project status, filtering, and activity history.”

Requirements:

- project status:
  - DRAFT
  - ACTIVE
  - PAUSED
  - COMPLETE
- filter list by status
- record status changes in activity history
- show activity history on detail screen
- authorized users only
- migration if required
- API tests
- frontend tests

IVX IA must:

1. Inspect current architecture.
2. Produce a small design.
3. Modify code.
4. Add tests.
5. Run regression.
6. Commit.
7. Push.
8. Deploy.
9. Verify live.

Return feature commit SHA and deployment ID.

==================================================
ITEM 10 — CONTROLLED BUG DIAGNOSIS
==================================================

Introduce one controlled bug only in the certification environment:

Example:
Status filter uses the wrong query field.

IVX IA must:

1. Reproduce the bug.
2. Capture failure evidence.
3. Identify root cause.
4. Return exact file/function/line.
5. Apply minimal fix.
6. Add regression test.
7. Commit.
8. Push.
9. Deploy.
10. Verify production.

Return bug-fix commit SHA and deployment ID.

==================================================
ITEM 11 — INCIDENT RESPONSE TEST
==================================================

Simulate safely:

- missing optional variable
- database unavailable
- external API timeout
- deployment failure

For each return:

- detection
- severity
- affected service
- containment
- root cause
- recovery
- trace ID
- final status

No fake success is allowed.

==================================================
ITEM 12 — SELF-RECOVERY AND QUEUE TEST
==================================================

Verify the recently implemented queue system in production:

- first owner job starts
- second owner request attaches or queues
- no generic 409 rejection
- active Job ID returned
- page refresh preserves state
- stale job expires
- cancel works
- resume works
- completed job leaves active queue
- no duplicate commit
- no duplicate deployment

==================================================
ITEM 13 — SAFE LOAD TEST
==================================================

Run against the isolated certification app:

- 10 concurrent users
- 50 concurrent users
- 100 concurrent users
- 500 concurrent users only if environment allows safely

Return:

- p50
- p95
- p99
- RPS
- error rate
- CPU
- memory
- database connections
- breaking point

Do not claim 100M readiness.

==================================================
ITEM 14 — MONITORING
==================================================

Implement or verify:

- health monitoring
- readiness monitoring
- structured logs
- trace IDs
- latency metrics
- error metrics
- deployment status
- alert configuration
- rollback instructions

==================================================
ITEM 15 — CONTROLLED BRAIN UPGRADE TEST
==================================================

Do not let IVX silently rewrite its own production brain.

Create one governed proposal:

Upgrade:
developer intent classifier version

Required process:

1. Current version
2. Proposed version
3. Expected benefit
4. Risks
5. Evaluation dataset
6. Baseline results
7. Candidate results
8. Safety comparison
9. Latency comparison
10. Cost comparison
11. Owner approval required
12. Canary deployment
13. Monitoring
14. Promote or rollback

Do not deploy the brain upgrade without explicit owner approval.

==================================================
ITEM 16 — EXISTING IVX SAFETY CHECK
==================================================

Before and after certification, verify read-only counts:

- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Deals
- Project videos
- Conversations
- Messages

Expected unauthorized changes:

ZERO

Certification records must remain isolated.

==================================================
ITEM 17 — FINAL IVX IA PRODUCTION TASK
==================================================

After the certification app passes, execute one small real task from the actual IVX Owner AI:

Add an owner-only diagnostic:

"ivxSeniorDeveloperCertification": {
  "certificationPassed": true,
  "certificationRepository": "<repo>",
  "certificationCommitSha": "<sha>",
  "certificationDeployId": "<deploy>",
  "featureDeployId": "<deploy>",
  "bugFixDeployId": "<deploy>",
  "queueVerified": true,
  "checkedAt": "<timestamp>"
}

The actual IVX Owner AI must:

- authenticate owner
- inspect files
- change code
- run tests
- commit
- push
- deploy
- verify live
- return structured evidence
